name: How should I prepare for a bathroom expansion consultation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for a bathroom expansion consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, identify which features are essential, such as a freestanding tub, walk-in shower, or dedicated linen closet. Note which rooms border the bathroom and whether you are open to giving up closet space or room footage. Gathering rough dimensions, photographs of current fixtures, and a clear idea of your overall budget will help guide the discussion. Also check if your electrical panel has room for new circuits if you plan to add high-draw items like radiant heating or high-capacity exhaust fans.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your must-have fixtures, decide what adjacent space you are willing to give up, and set a clear budget before your initial contractor consultation.
